section.div: Firehat is an open-source FireWire HAT for single-board computers with PCIe. It adds a VIA VT6315N IEEE 1394 controller and a 6-pin FireWire/i.LINK/DV port for connecting DV camcorders, decks, and other FireWire devices to modern SBCs.
Real-time time stretcher, pitch shifter, envelope follower, and transient detector firmware for the Hermetic Modular Alchemy Lab. AGPL-3.0.
Embedded SDK for Hermetic Modular eurorack modules, built on Electrosmith Daisy.
Efficient and minimal collaborative code editor, self-hosted, no database required
All b:art instruments schematics, PCB designs and code made available for everyone to download.

Btrfs Assistant is a GUI management tool to make managing a Btrfs filesystem. Forked from https://gitlab.com/btrfs-assistant/btrfs-assistant.

reFrame is an experimental camera with a color ePaper display. Designed to capture and display one photo at a time, making every frame deliberate and memorable.
